summary: Leaving the fabric pattern aside (the photo-cut tiles are being done in parallel), the biggest remaining gaps are shape gaps on the soft goods and the front structure, plus one value gap. (1) Headrest height and the back top: the pad sits about 2.5 cm lower than in 3 of the 4 paired photos. In econUnitFar the white hood box (top 0.88) also stands 2 cm above the back (top 0.86), so every far-row back gets a white cap. (2) The pillow is too flat: its p90/p10 luminance spread is 1.28-1.37, against 2.2-2.8 in y_47300. (3) The seat pans are flat-faced boxes sitting in a white tray, where the photo shows a deep fabric bullnose over a dark underside. (4) The armrest has no J-shaped support beam (y_47303). (5) The cover value at row distance: cover/fabric is about 0.9 in the render against about 0.6 in the photo, and the cover saturation is 0.47-0.51 against 0.26-0.39. The working-tree yCover edit already moves toward this; the item gives the acceptance targets. Expected total is about +0.55 on top of the fabric swap, which would put the area at about 8.3-8.6. Triangle cost is about +30-90k (to about 1.06-1.12M).

items.title: Pillow: give it real volume (about 10 cm thick instead of 6 cm), lean it back a little more, and let its lower half fall into shadow.
items.ladderLevel: silhouette and proportion (pillow volume) -> value structure (form shading)
items.evidence:
Luminance inside the pillow, y_47300 front row vs render:
- y_47300 seats 1-3: L10/50/90 28/50/78, 23/36/57 and 26/44/56, so p90/p10 is 2.8, 2.5 and 2.2. The vertical profile falls 65 -> 30 from top to bottom: a puffy cushion whose lower half curves under, away from the light.
- Studio e1 (sc1): p90/p10 1.28, profile 60 -> 45.
- In-cabin q15: 1.30-1.37, profile 56 -> 43.

Outline and size are fine (raters 7.5 / 8). The volume is not: the code's half-thickness is 0.004 + 0.026*sqrt(1-l^4), about 6 cm in total. pillow_cmp.png shows the render as a flat padded board. The photo shows a pillow-shaped pillow, with a concave top edge between pointed corners and a bulging face.

The pillow is the most prominent soft good in the paired hero shot y_47300: four big dark shapes along the bottom edge.
items.expectedGain: +0.1 (pillow 7.5 / 8 -> 8.5, and better tonal structure in the lower third of y_47300 / q15)
items.cheapestFix:
In the pillow loop:
- Change `g.p[k+1] = sy*(0.004+0.026*Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-Math.pow(l,4))))` to `sy*(0.006+0.046*Math.pow(Math.max(0,1-Math.pow(l,3)),0.6))`. That gives about 10.4 cm at the centre, with a fuller shoulder and a thin seamed rim.
- Move the placement from M4.trs(0, 0.14, -0.10, 0, -80*DEG) to M4.trs(0, 0.15, -0.12, 0, -76*DEG), so the thicker body clears the back crown and the bottom half overhangs the pan.
- Make the top edge a little concave: in the X term, use (1 - 0.1*(1-Z*Z)) -> (1 - 0.06*(1-Z*Z)) on the sides and add -0.04*(1-X*X) to the top half only (Z>0).

Triangle cost: 0 (gSphere 24x12 unchanged). Optionally, 32x16 for a smoother silhouette costs about +470 tris per seat, about +55k over the 116 seats.

items.title: Seat pan: a deep rolled fabric bullnose over a dark underside, instead of a flat-faced box sitting in a white tray
items.evidence:
y_47302 middle seat, 422 px/m (pan_cmp.png, g_p02pan.png):
- The pan front is one continuous roll. The fabric darkens steadily from the top edge (y 375) to the underside (y 410), with no flat vertical face.
- The plan corners are round, about 25 px, or about 6 cm.
- Under the front edge is dark (the under-seat cavity, with the white electronics box). There is no light lip.

Render (e1 / e7 / e1_bottom.png):
- The pan is cushionSecs(0.43, 0.47, 0.095, ..., edge 0.034, r 0.03). That is a 3.4 cm top roll over a vertical wall, with 3 cm plan corners.
- It sits in a 0.44 x 0.46 yShellDark tray (y 0.33-0.37), wider than the pan's 0.41 base and level with its front. That shows as a continuous 1.5-2 cm light lip along the pan front and sides.
- The light-grey 0.30 x 0.04 stiffener at z -0.45 adds a second light bar under it.

Raters scored 'seat pan / front' 7 / 7.5.
items.expectedGain: +0.1 (seat pan / front 7 / 7.5 -> 8; also helps the y_47302 / 47303 comparisons)

In econSeat, replace the pan line with the following.
```
const ps = cushionSecs(0.43, 0.47, 0.095, -0.05, { edge: 0.05, r: 0.05, crown: 0.01 });
```

items.title: Armrest: add the J-shaped support beam under the arm (diagonal down from the rear, then horizontal forward about 7.5 cm under the arm) in place of the slim raked rear blade
items.evidence:
y_47303 near armrest (arm_cmp.png, about 485 px/m from the 0.33 m arm):
- The padded arm is 23 px thick, or 4.7 cm.
- Under it, a separate light-grey beam of the same 4.7 cm runs forward horizontally, about 0.25 m long, with its top 37 px (7.6 cm) below the arm's underside.
- At its rear it rises diagonally (about 40 deg) back up to the arm's rear underside. The beam is #b2b7c4 (B/R 1.10), the arm top #bec0ca-#c0c4ca.

Lower roughness can bloom under the cove light from the high q15 camera. A rater on y_47300 then sees bright covers again, which is why the far-LOD fallback exists.

Head-on, the cover is a camera question too: q15 is about 0.3 m higher than y_47300 and sees more ceiling reflection.

notForEcon.issue: Missing deep darks at row distance. Over the rows 2-6 band, y_47300 has L p5/p10 38/44 (shadow gaps between rows, under the pads, the lower pillow halves). q15 has 58/61, so the darkest tones are lifted about 50 %. The econ geometry items (pad shoulders, pillow volume, pan overhang) make the occluders. The contact shadow / AO strength between seat rows, and under the pad and pillow, belongs to 12_scene.js / 04_shaders.js.

Leatherette sheen on the cover. y_47301 near cover p90/p50 is 2.55 (a broad grey specular band from the cove and bins) against 1.57 in q16. If r 0.5 cannot produce the band without head-on bloom, the satin needs a broader, lower-intensity specular (a sheen lobe) for LAYER.leather.

- q17 looks aft at the rear shells, while y_47303 is a window-side view of the seat fronts. The J armrest (item 4) and the pan bullnose (item 3) are never compared in the cabin.
- q18 sits further back than y_47305.
